description: This source file contains unit tests for the DrugOrderValidator class within the OpenMRS project. It tests various validation scenarios for drug orders, ensuring compliance with business rules and correct handling of different input cases.

classes.name: DrugOrderValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the validation logic of drug orders within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfAsNeededIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the 'asNeeded' field is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDosingTypeIsNull
methods.description: Tests validation failure when 'dosingType' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailValidationIfDrugIsNull
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when 'drug' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Validates that a properly populated DrugOrder passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfQuantityIsNullForOutpatientCareSetting
methods.description: Checks validation failure when 'quantity' is null in outpatient settings.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNumberOfRefillsIsNullForOutpatientCareSetting
methods.description: Checks validation failure when 'numRefills' is null in outpatient settings.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailValidationIfQuantityAndNumRefillsAreNullIfConfiguredToNotRequire
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if config allows null for quantity and refills.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDoseIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when 'dose' is null for simple dosing instructions.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDoseUnitsIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when 'doseUnits' is null for simple dosing instructions.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRouteIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when 'route' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFrequencyIsNullForSimpleDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when 'frequency' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDosingInstructionsIsNullForFreeTextDosingInstructionsDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation failure when 'dosingInstructions' is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDoseUnitsIsNullWhenDoseIsPresent
methods.description: Checks validation failure if 'doseUnits' is null when 'dose' is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfQuantityUnitsIsNullWhenQuantityIsPresent
methods.description: Checks validation failure if 'quantityUnits' is null when 'quantity' is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDurationUnitsIsNullWhenDurationIsPresent
methods.description: Checks validation failure if 'durationUnits' is null when 'duration' is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfRouteIsNotAValidConcept
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if 'route' concept is not among allowed concepts.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptIsNullAndDrugIsNotSpecified
methods.description: Fails validation if both 'concept' and 'drug' are null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptIsNullAndCannotInferItFromDrug
methods.description: Fails validation if 'concept' is null and 'drug' has no concept.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfConceptIsNullAndDrugIsSet
methods.description: Validation passes if 'concept' is null but 'drug' is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfConceptIsNullAndDrugNonCodedIsSet
methods.description: Validation passes if 'concept' is null but 'drugNonCoded' is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldApplyValidationForACustomDosingType
methods.description: Checks validation rules for custom dosing instructions.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotValidateACustomDosingTypeAgainstAnyOtherDosingTypeValidation
methods.description: Ensures that custom dosing type validation does not interfere with other types.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldFailDrugOrderWithoutADrugWhenDrugOrderRequireDrugGBIsTrue
methods.description: Ensures validation error when 'drug' is missing and requirement is true.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldPassDrugOrderWithoutADrugWhenDrugOrderRequireDrugGBIsFalse
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when 'drug' is omitted but requirement is false.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldPassDrugOrderWithoutADrugWhenDrugOrderRequireDrugGBIsNotSet
methods.description: Validates behavior when the global property for requiring drugs is not set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfDurationUnitsHasNoMappingToSNOMEDCTSource
methods.description: Fails validation if 'durationUnits' are not mapped to SNOMED CT source.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation passes with proper string lengths.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation failure with overly long string fields.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldFailDrugOrderWithBothDrugNonCodedAndDrugAreSetForDrugOrder
methods.description: Fails validation if both 'drug' and 'drugNonCoded' are set.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldFailDrugOrderWithNeitherDrugNonCodedNorDrugAreSetForDrugOrderWhenDrugRequiredSet
methods.description: Fails if neither 'drug' nor 'drugNonCoded' are set and requirement is true.

methods.name: saveOrder_shouldPassDrugOrderWithNeitherDrugNonCodedNorDrugAreSetForDrugOrderWhenDrugRequiredISNotSet
methods.description: Validation passes if requirement for drug is not set and neither 'drug' nor 'drugNonCoded' are provided.
